QuestInfo.name: The Time Wanderer
QuestInfo.0: Ask the Record Keeper about the Amnesiac Temple Keeper's lost memories.
QuestInfo.1: The Record Keeper believes the Amnesiac Temple Keeper lost his memories because he 'lost his time'... He told you to say those words to the Temple Keeper. Is that some kind of code word?\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You took the Record Keeper's message to the Temple Keeper.

0.0: I know why you have come. However, I cannot give you the answer you are seeking.\r\n
0.1: Retrieving memories is a personal journey, not one you can join. What he lost was his own time... If you still desire a way to be of aid, tell the #p2140000# exactly that. Tell him 'he lost his time'.

no.0: Being able to forget is a blessing granted to humans by the Goddess of Time. His loss, however, is something entirely different.

1.0: Have you met with the #p2140003#? He records the entire history of the Maple World. The only thing he can't tell you is what happens next. \r\n

yes.0: He lost.. his time? What does that mean?

npc.0: The Amnesiac Temple Keeper lost his own time... Tell this to the #p2140000#.
